meaning: This is a REQUIREMENT TRACKING STRUCTURE; technical mapping is a proposal not original Verbatim and no version is certified fully compliant.

requirements.experimental_mapping: Real training and measured held-out evaluation without toy success claims

versions.notes: One persistent PyTorch model+graph across 5 physical/symbolic worlds and optional real byte-text. Eight local CPU tests passed; no 14M, no proven cross-domain gains, no full transcript coverage.
V10 backward compatible fixes; 14 CPU tests (one actual pyarrow test skipped locally), requires real shard and CUDA verification on user machine.
